profile: Westrock Coffee provides coffee, tea, flavors, extracts, and ingredients solutions, including sourcing, supply chain management, product development, roasting, packaging, and distribution. Its beverage products include branded and private-label coffee, tea, ready-to-drink beverages, and extracts for cold brew and other offerings. The company serves retail, food service, restaurant, convenience store, travel center, non-commercial, consumer packaged goods, and hospitality customers in the United States, Europe, and Asia.
